objective.subject: docs: run worktree skill check in the owned worktree and default to durable PIT evidence
objective.body:
MUST: run `(cd .worktrees/<topic> && python3 scripts/check-worktree-skills.py)`
inside a new worktree before invoking a skill there; the script inspects the
checkout containing it, so the shared checkout's copy proves nothing about the
new worktree.

MUST: run core PIT partitions through
`scripts/run-pit-core.sh --batch <A|B|C|D|E|all> --out <archive-dir>`, which
archives each batch's XML, log, monitor data, and run metadata.

MUST: copy `core/target/pit-reports/mutations.xml` and its log out of build
output to durable evidence when a focused inline PIT run is used, before any
clean, rebuild, or worktree removal.

MUST: record the archived XML in the delivery ledger's `--pit` input.

MUST NOT: pass `target/pit-reports/mutations.xml` as the ledger PIT path; core
PIT output lives under `core/target/pit-reports/`.
